messages:
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY REQUEST] hotfix/v2.3.7 -> prod-eu1. Reason: P0 tokenization 502s for short prompts. Change window: immediate. Requested expedited approvals: eng-releases, infra, oncall, security. Canary plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% OR p95 latency > 800ms. Release note: small tokenizer edge-case fix, model pin v2.3.7-quant.

olivia: Patch landed in hotfix/v2.3.7, tests + unit/tokenizer fuzz passed. Strong preference: do not skip canary — we need to validate quant kernel.

raj: Oncall here. Seeing the 502 spike in eu1 now. +1 expedite. I can monitor dashboards and hit rollback if things degrade.

kevin: Infra: eu1 has spare capacity for a rolling deploy. Approve, but keep conservative canary durations. Suggest 10% for 10m, then 50% for 5m.

sam: Eng-SRE: logging hooks + extra traces pushed to hotfix branch. Also added metric flush to avoid stale p95. Command ready below.

sam: ```
/deploy start --env prod-eu1 --ref hotfix/v2.3.7 --canary 10 --canary-duration 600 --target inference
```

maria: Security quick-check: no IAM/KMS changes. +1 from security.

jess: Product: customer comms drafted for impacted accounts, will send on final confirmation. +1.

micah: LGTM. Note: pin model to v2.3.7-quant during rollout to avoid auto-kernel upgrades.

olivia: Approved. Start canary when ready. Please ack when canary metrics look good.

deploy-bot: /deploy start accepted. Canary starting at 10% now (10:12 UTC). Tracking id: deploy-2539876543.

raj: Initial 5m look: error rate trending down, still seeing a few 502s but volume much lower. Holding.

sam: 10m metrics: p95 down to 420ms, 5xx ~0.12%. Logs show tokenizer fix applied. Recommend promote to 50%.

kevin: Applying promote to 50% now. Command: ```/deploy promote --id deploy-2539876543 --to 50```

deploy-bot: Promote scheduled, will start rolling now. ETA ~3m.

deploy-bot: Promote complete — currently at 50% (10:27 UTC). No rollback conditions tripped.

olivia: Taking metric ownership for the next 15m. Reminder rollback criteria: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 800ms.

micah: 15m checkpoint: p95 stable, errors flat. Ready for full rollout in 10m unless objections.

sam: Second checkpoint green. Proceed to 100%.

kevin: Rolling to 100% now. Nodes draining and updating.

deploy-bot: Roll to 100% started. Rolling updates in progress.

deploy-bot: Roll to 100% complete. All inference nodes on prod-eu1 at hotfix/v2.3.7 (10:45 UTC).

jess: Sending customer notifications now.

maria: Audit log entry created, retention note attached.

olivia: Closing thread — hotfix deployed, monitoring for 1h. Huge thanks team. :tada:
